description.zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符。
description.en: The ID of the application. This ID is generated when you create the application in the console. The ID contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length.

description.zh: 自定义消息体的内容，大小不超过2048个字节。
description.en: The content of the custom message body. The maximum size is 2048 bytes.

description.zh: 自定义消息的接收人用户ID列表，最大长度不超过100。
description.en: The list of recipient user IDs for the custom message. The maximum length is 100.

description.zh: 房间的唯一标识，在调用CreateRoom时返回。
description.en: The unique identifier of the room, returned when you call CreateRoom.

title.zh: 指定房间成员发送自定义消息
title.en: Send custom message to specified room members
